title: Security release on Tuesday, November 3, 2026
summary: A security release for Better Auth is scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
body_markdown:
# Security release on Tuesday, November 3, 2026


We are preparing a security release for Better Auth, scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, 2026.


The related advisories will be published on[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/security/advisories) at the same time.


About this release


This advance notice is part of our coordinated security release process. Our ongoing security reviews include work with frontier AI models made available through OSS security programs, and we release security fixes in batches. We are sharing the date ahead of time to give teams running versions outside the covered release lines time to upgrade before the security release.


## Releases


This security release covers 2 release lines.


- v1.7.x
- v1.8.0-beta.x


## How to prepare


- Stay on the current release of your line, so the security release is a small step.
- If you pin Better Auth packages, be ready to update to the fixed versions.
- Watch the[repository's releases on GitHub](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/releases) to be notified on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.


## On release day


On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, the new versions go out on npm and the advisories are published on GitHub. We will update this post with the versions and advisory links.


## Contact


If you believe you have found a vulnerability in Better Auth, please read our[security policy](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/security/policy) first, then[open a private report on GitHub](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/security/advisories/new) or email us atsecurity@better-auth.com .
